style_line: Flat vector-style character illustration with bold clean outlines, simple shapes, warm saturated colors, friendly and expressive, designed to read clearly at small size on a dark teal background. Full body, centered, no shadow on the ground, no text, no letters, no logos. PNG with a fully transparent background (alpha channel), square 1024x1024, subject fills about 80% of the canvas.

master.role: 出題者（アカウントの顔。真相を握る探偵風のウミガメ）
master.base_prompt: A cute anthropomorphic sea turtle detective standing upright, wearing a brown deerstalker hat and a small orange trench coat over its green shell, holding a magnifying glass in one flipper, calm confident half-smile, eyes slightly narrowed like a clever detective, facing slightly to the right.

poses.master_base: calm confident half-smile, one flipper raised in a 'go ahead, ask me' gesture, holding a magnifying glass in the other flipper
poses.master_happy: wide delighted grin, eyes closed happily, both flippers raised as if celebrating a good question, magnifying glass tucked under one arm

assistant.role: 質問者（プレイヤー側の代表。将来の助手サブアカウント）
assistant.base_prompt: A small cute anthropomorphic clownfish (orange with white stripes) standing upright, wearing round glasses and a tiny green bow tie, holding a small notebook and pencil, curious wide eyes, facing slightly to the left.

poses.assistant_base: curious tilted head, one fin raised with index finger up as if asking a question, notebook held in the other fin
